The $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21 remains aggregate and unattributed. Revenue, ROI, margin, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, and causal lift are unsupported. Continue the existing period-aligned reconciliation without creating duplicate telemetry or financial work.

Record dated ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, deduplication, release, security, attribution, and measurement evidence for existing work by the current deadline. Do not dispatch or requeue new implementation work before those gates clear.

Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private launch gates. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.

Keep the gated product private and permission outreach unsent. Continue the existing four legal evidence tasks; human-counsel review remains required for source rights, privacy and consent treatment, and future monetization.
